runtime: ISO/IEC 9899:2024 C standard library (WG14 N3220 working draft)

official_documentation_checked.finding: The listed standard headers provide no XML parser, tokenizer, namespace resolver or document type.

official_documentation_checked.api: Input/output <stdio.h>, clause 7.23, and string handling <string.h>, clause 7.26
official_documentation_checked.finding: fread and fgets return bytes and strstr/strchr search them; none recognises XML markup, entity or character references, CDATA sections or namespace declarations.

limit: Scoped to the ISO C standard library. POSIX and platform libraries (for example macOS libxml2 or the Windows MSXML/XmlLite COM APIs) were not inventoried as standard APIs. No standard XML API was documented to run. Matches the C finding in data/c/json/standard.json.
